title: A PIPELINE FOR ENABLING PATH-SPECIFIC CAUSAL FAIRNESS IN OBSERVATIONAL HEALTH DATA

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating path-specific causal effects (Natural Direct Effect, Natural Indirect Effect, and Spurious Effect) using doubly robust estimators to quantify direct and indirect gender disparities in clinical risk prediction tasks for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).

Estimating path-specific causal effects (Natural Direct Effect, Natural Indirect Effect, and Spurious Effect) using doubly robust estimators to quantify direct and indirect racial disparities (comparing Black and White individuals) in clinical risk prediction tasks for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and schizophrenia (SCZ).
